page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r6.xlarge is a memory-optimized instance built on the KVM hypervisor. It is equipped with an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor operating at a clock speed of 2.5 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The hardware configuration provides 4 dedicated vCPUs from 2 physical cores with hyper-threading, 32.0 GB of RAM, and no local storage. It features a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps.

Benchmark results show a clear tradeoff between memory capacity and processing performance. The instance achieves average scores in Geekbench single-core and Passmark memory tests. However, its multi-core CPU performance, stress-ng benchmarks, and Passmark database operations are positioned in the bottom 25% tier. Cryptographic, compression, and decompression tasks also register weak performance, with bzip3 multi-threaded decompression falling into the bottom 10% tier.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.r6.xlarge offers a high density of memory relative to its compute resources, making it suitable for memory-bound workloads that do not require intensive CPU processing. Recommended workloads include in-memory caching, lightweight database operations, and enterprise applications with a larger memory footprint.
